def transform_fixed(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    vertical=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))]
    horizontal=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==2 for v in g[r])]
    if vertical:
        div=vertical[0]
        vals={v for row in g for v in row if v!=2}
        bg=max(vals,key=lambda x:sum(v==x for row in g for v in row))
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (2,bg)]
        if pts:
            lo=min(c for r,c in pts); hi=max(c for r,c in pts)
            target=hi+1 if lo>div else lo-1
            if 0<=target<w:
                for r in range(h):
                    if g[r][target]==bg:g[r][target]=8
        return g
    if horizontal:
        div=horizontal[0]
        vals={v for row in g for v in row if v!=2}
        bg=max(vals,key=lambda x:sum(v==x for row in g for v in row))
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (2,bg)]
        if pts:
            lo=min(r for r,c in pts); hi=max(r for r,c in pts)
            target=hi+1 if lo>div else lo-1
            if 0<=target<h:
                for c in range(w):
                    if g[target][c]==bg:g[target][c]=8
        return g
    return g

expected=[row[:] for row in demo]
for r in range(24): expected[r][6]=8
print(transform_fixed(demo)==expected)
